heading: Frequently Asked Questions
text2: Quick answers to the questions we hear most about this service.

items.question: Angular or AngularJS?
items.answer: AngularJS is the older version. For new projects we use modern Angular and can migrate older apps.

items.question: Can Angular work with my backend?
items.answer: Yes. Angular consumes REST and GraphQL APIs from any backend.

items.question: Is Angular good for dashboards?
items.answer: Yes. Its component model suits data-heavy dashboards and admin tools.

items.question: How long does angularjs development take?
items.answer: A business website usually takes 4 to 8 weeks, while custom web applications take 3 to 6 months depending on features and integrations.

items.question: Do you offer support after launch?
items.answer: Yes. We provide maintenance, updates, monitoring and new feature development after launch.
